statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle below 100.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-27. Reference: 112.00 on the packet date, 2026-10-28.
resolution: True if the official ICE daily settlement price of the front-month Brent crude futures contract is below 100.00 on any trading day from 2026-10-29 through 2026-11-27 inclusive. Reference: 112.00 on 2026-10-28.
failure_condition: Every ICE front-month Brent settlement from 2026-10-29 through 2026-11-27 is at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel.

control_basis.rule: climatological, trailing - the realized hit rate of the mirrored arm's own resolved rows, by the first step of the ladder with at least 10 rows (registration v4, Section 3)
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. The floor the mirrored arm must clear, priced from its own record; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The Wendys Company (NASDAQ: WEN) files a Form 8-K with the SEC between 2026-10-29 and 2027-01-29 announcing a signed definitive agreement to be acquired in whole by Trian Fund Management or any other party.
resolution: True if SEC EDGAR shows a Wendys Form 8-K filed between 2026-10-29 and 2027-01-29 disclosing a signed definitive agreement for the acquisition of the whole company; non-binding proposals or letters of intent do not count.
failure_condition: No Wendys Form 8-K filed between 2026-10-29 and 2027-01-29 discloses a signed definitive whole-company acquisition agreement; an offer still pending, withdrawn, or rejected at the deadline is a MISS.

statement: CISA adds at least one CVE affecting Oracle E-Business Suite to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-27.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog JSON contains at least one entry with vendorProject Oracle, product naming E-Business Suite, and dateAdded between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-27 inclusive.
failure_condition: At the deadline the KEV catalog carries no Oracle E-Business Suite entry whose dateAdded falls between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-27, whether because the entry was added on or before 2026-10-28 or has not been added at all.

statement: Between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-18 a US federal agency (FEC, CISA, FBI, ODNI, or DOJ) publicly attributes the October 2026 intrusion into the FEC campaign finance filing system to a named foreign government, threat group, or charged individual.
resolution: True if an official FEC, CISA, FBI, ODNI, or DOJ statement, advisory, or charging document published between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-18 names a specific foreign government, threat group, or charged individual as responsible for the FEC filing-system intrusion.
failure_condition: At the deadline no official US federal statement, advisory, or charging document issued between 2026-10-29 and 2026-12-18 has named a responsible government, group, or individual; anonymous-official press leaks and private-sector attribution do not count.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least one magnitude 6.0 or greater earthquake with epicenter in the Vanuatu region box 12S-21S, 164E-171E, with origin time between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-27 UTC.
resolution: True if the USGS ComCat catalog lists at least one event with magnitude 6.0 or greater, origin time between 2026-10-29T00:00Z and 2026-11-27T23:59Z, and epicenter within latitude 12S-21S and longitude 164E-171E.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog shows no event of magnitude 6.0 or greater inside the stated box with origin time between 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-27 UTC, after any magnitude revisions in effect at the deadline.
